note: Re-judged 2026-10-20 (independent judge, after 7f34543a08). Section 7.6.1: "Otherwise, if this ancestor is a case node, the default value MUST be used if any node from the case exists in the data tree or the case node is the choice's default case, and if no nodes from any other case exist in the data tree." Producer: ApplyDefaults now asks choiceMembers.skipsDefaults before each child; yangToContainer and yangToList record the goyang entry of every child a choice holds (cases.record in both the container and the list choice branch), mergeContainer and mergeNode carry it (adopt), and skipsDefaults calls yang.CaseInEffect for leaves and non-presence containers, leaving presence containers and lists to their own existing-ancestor rule. CaseInEffect climbs every choice between the node and its data parent: in effect when exactly one case holds data and it is this one, or none does and this is the default case; two cases holding data put no case in effect. Positive TestRFC7950CaseDefaultsFollowTheCaseInEffect asserts exact defaults for the case holding data (a2, c2, inside a list entry) and the default case (b1 and the non-presence container bc/bd) with no data; negative TestRFC7950CaseDefaultsIgnoredOutsideTheCaseInEffect asserts exact maps: no other case's default, no non-default case without data, nothing when two cases hold data, nothing for a choice with no default case, list entry, merged container. Mutant records on skipsDefaults (data->nil; inverted predicate) verify. Judge probes via -overlay, all RFC-correct: nested choice in the default case (no data -> outer default case leaf and inner default case x; inner non-default case data -> its default plus the outer case's default; data in another outer case -> only that case's defaults; data in both outer cases -> none); default leaf in a non-presence container of a non-default case (not created with no data, created when a sibling of that case holds data, filled when the container itself is present); shorthand cases; nested choice inside a case container. Scope: no shipped ApplyDefaults caller defaults a node that holds a choice today (bgp peer, rib distance, filter-modify, the tunnel case container), so the proof is at ApplyDefaults over yangToNode, the converter the config schema uses; the reference walk reads the same CaseInEffect. go test ./internal/component/config/ ./internal/component/config/yang/ green at HEAD.
